It is seldom used now.|[[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Galia]]|audio=OmminsLab-TotJ.flac|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
Within the depths of the [[Iziz Royal Palace|royal palace]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] was a''' laboratory '''that belonged to [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]]. The laboratory was an old, abandoned, storage facility that housed spare parts for Ommin's [[Ommin's mechanical exoskeleton|mechanical exoskeleton]] as well as decommissioned and dilapidated [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. It was in King Ommin's laboratory where [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Cay Qel-Droma]], after recently losing his [[Limb/Legends|arm]] in [[Battle of Iziz|battle]] with [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]]'s [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]], found the spare appendage of an old [[XT-6 droid|XT-6 model droid]] to serve as a [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic replacement]] limb.
